h1: Blue House Ang Thong — a small, clean, owner-run boutique stay right in town on a budget
intro: If you want an in-town Ang Thong stay that's small, quiet, spotlessly clean and run hands-on by a friendly owner — all for under ฿1,000 — Blue House is a 14-room boutique place tucked by the irrigation canal in Talat Luang, Mueang Ang Thong. Rooms are apartment-style with a balcony, air conditioning, flat-screen TV and an en-suite shower, plus free private parking, free Wi-Fi and morning coffee, tea and toast. It sits right in town, within walking distance of restaurants and the market, and starts at around ฿700/night — ideal if you want a quiet, clean in-town base without spending much.

body.html: What sets Blue House apart from the usual block hotels in town is that it's a small boutique stay run hands-on by the owner. There are only about 14 rooms, tucked into a quiet corner by the irrigation canal in central Ang Thong, with apartment-style rooms and private balconies. Guests repeatedly mention how friendly and helpful the owner and staff are — it feels more like staying with someone you know than checking into a hotel.

The location works well for an in-town base. Blue House sits in Talat Luang, Mueang Ang Thong, right by the canal, within walking distance of restaurants and the market, and a short drive from the Chao Phraya riverfront and the city pillar shrine. It also makes a handy stopover: it's about 30 km from Ayutthaya, so it suits anyone passing through or planning an Ayutthaya–Ang Thong trip.

Rooms come as Deluxe doubles or twins, some with a balcony. Each has air conditioning, a flat-screen TV and an en-suite shower with a hairdryer. What real reviews bring up most often is the cleanliness and the great water pressure — many call the rooms clean, comfortable and good value. In the morning there's coffee, tea and toast — a light start rather than a big buffet, but enough to get going.
"Clean rooms, the host is very friendly, the water pressure is amazing and it's great value — the best place I've stayed in Ang Thong."

To be straight with you, this is a small budget-priced stay and there still aren't many reviews. Most scores are strong — especially for staff, value and comfort — but a few are middling, with the odd mention of small ants in room corners and some upkeep that's still basic. That's fairly typical of a small, owner-run boutique place, so it's worth checking recent photos and reviews on a few platforms before booking.

One more thing to know: it mainly takes cash and the facilities are kept simple — no pool or gym. The draw is clean rooms, a hands-on owner, free parking, free Wi-Fi and morning coffee and toast. Check-in is 14:00–22:00, so let them know if you'll arrive later. It's best for a one- or two-night stay, or as a base for temple-hopping and markets around Ang Thong, rather than a long resort-style getaway.

Overall, Blue House is a likeable budget pick among Ang Thong's stays. It isn't luxury and the reviews are still thin, but judged on clean rooms, a friendly owner, an in-town spot within walking distance of food, free parking and morning coffee — at a rate starting around ฿700 and rising with the season and room type — it does the job of a quiet, clean, friendly in-town base nicely on a budget. Just go in expecting simple facilities and bring enough cash.

faqTitle: Frequently asked questions — Blue House Ang Thong

faq.q: Where is Blue House in Ang Thong, and what's nearby?
faq.a: Blue House is at 44 Rimklongchonlapratan Road, Talat Luang, Mueang Ang Thong. It's right in town, within walking distance of restaurants and the market, and a short drive from the Chao Phraya River and the city pillar shrine. It's about 30 km from Ayutthaya.

faq.q: How much does Blue House cost, and what room types are there?
faq.a: Rates start at around ฿700/night for a Deluxe room. There are double, twin and balcony options, with prices rising by season and room type — always compare a few platforms before booking.

faq.q: Who is Blue House best for?
faq.a: It suits anyone wanting a small, quiet, clean in-town stay run hands-on by the owner on a budget — couples, solo travellers, or anyone breaking up an Ayutthaya–Ang Thong trip. It isn't about luxury or full facilities, but the rooms are clean, the welcome is warm and the price is low.

faq.q: Anything to watch out for when booking Blue House?
faq.a: Since it's a small budget boutique stay with still-thin reviews and it mainly takes cash, check recent photos and reviews across a few sites, bring enough cash, and message your check-in time ahead — especially for evening or late arrivals (check-in 14:00–22:00).
